# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]

# Building a world of health around every individual

We connect people to the care they need, put medicine and wellness within reach, and drive greater
affordability, simplicity and convenience in everything we do.

## Combining our strengths for you

Health services Health insurance Pharmacy Prescription drug coverage

### Health services

We have an unmatched ability to reach people and provide them with access to the affordable, quality
health care and wellbeing services they need to live their healthiest lives.

[Explore our services ][110]

### Health insurance

Aetna® creates insurance plans that deliver a total, connected, affordable approach to health care.

[Discover Aetna plans ][111]

### Pharmacy

Our neighborhood pharmacies — as well as our prescription delivery and specialty medication services
— are making it as easy as possible for people to get the care they depend on.

[Visit our pharmacy page ][112]

### Prescription drug coverage

Our pharmacy benefit manager, CVS Caremark®, plays a critical role in the health care system by
helping to lower drug costs and expand coverage to the affordable medications people need to stay
healthy.

[Learn about drug coverage ][113]

Having 1 kid?...Not exactly simple.

Having 6 kids? Definitely not simple. Wait, that’s 8 people in one family. Whoa.

That means finding ONE tv show they’ll ALL watch.

Making ONE dinner they’ll ALL eat.

And how do you play a board game with 6 kids?…actually, that’s kinda simple.

Okaaay, not so simple.

But it’s not just tantrums.

It’s attitudes.

That’s right. Teenagers.

And how do you decide who gets the last piece of pizza?

But you don’t just have 6 kids, you have 6 kids all with chronic illnesses.

That means on top of it all, you have to manage over 50 prescriptions, medical checkups, and support
everyone’s mental health.

Luckily, you’re not alone…I mean Tricia, obviously YOU’RE not alone.

But you’ve also got CVS Health as your healthcare partner, to manage specialty medications, provide
walk-in appointments, and keep track of it all in the CVS Health app.

So, does that make everything…simple?

No. It makes it simple…er

And sometimes, “simpler” is all you need to live a little happier and healthier.

But who gets the last piece of pizza? That’s still your call.

When you need more than a pharmacy…

    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

savings account (HSA). It's the maximum amount of money you can put into the account for that
calendar year.

## A new company

On March 1, 2019, Singapore-headquartered Sivantos Group joined forces with Lynge/Denmark-based
Widex to form WS Audiology. Please visit [wsa.com][3] for access to all relevant information about
our current company where we strive to unlock human potential by making wonderful sound part of
everyone’s life.

 

Until January 2015, Sivantos Group was a Siemens business unit. That’s when we became an independent
entity. Ever since, Sivantos has worked hard to reshape the industry in terms of innovation with
cutting-edge products, services, and channels. Finally, in 2019, we merged with Widex to continue on
our path as WS Audiology.

## Alcon Completes Acquisition of Aerie Pharmaceuticals, Inc., Strengthening Company’s Ophthalmic
## Pharmaceutical Business

[Print][23]
* **Leveraging Alcon’s robust commercial capabilities and resources to drive further growth and
  access to Rocklatan^{ }and Rhopressa**
* **Acquisition adds pharmaceutical research and development capabilities and further expertise for
  future product pipeline**
* **Expands Alcon’s presence in the $20 billion global ophthalmic pharmaceutical category¹**

GENEVA--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Alcon (SIX/NYSE: ALC), the global leader in eye care dedicated to helping
people see brilliantly, today announced that it has completed its acquisition of Aerie
Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (NASDAQ: AERI, “Aerie”). This transaction helps bolster Alcon’s presence in
the ophthalmic pharmaceutical space with its growing portfolio of commercial products and
development pipeline.

“As we welcome the Aerie team to Alcon, we look forward to leveraging our expanding commercial
footprint and expertise to bring Rocklatan^{®} and Rhopressa^{®} to even more customers and their
patients,” said David Endicott, CEO of Alcon. “Alcon has a rich history in the ophthalmic
pharmaceutical space rooted in a deep understanding of Eye Care Professionals. We are excited to add
Aerie’s significant technical expertise to Alcon R&D, which enhances our efforts to build a
compelling portfolio of ophthalmic pharmaceuticals.”

Through the transaction, Alcon has added the commercial products Rocklatan^{}(netarsudil and
latanoprost ophthalmic solution) 0.02%/0.005% and Rhopressa^{}(netarsudil ophthalmic solution)
0.02%, as well as AR-15512, a Phase 3 product candidate for dry eye disease. Alcon has also acquired
a pipeline of ophthalmic pharmaceutical product candidates with the opportunity to leverage Aerie’s
existing research and development capabilities.

The transaction complements Alcon’s expansion intothe ophthalmic pharmaceutical space, including
acquisitions of the exclusive U.S. commercialization rights for Simbrinza^{® }from Novartis in April
2021 and Eysuvis^{®} and Inveltys^{®} from Kala Pharmaceuticals, Inc. in May 2022.

Alcon intends to fully integrate Aerie into its business. As previously disclosed, the Company has
used debt to fund the transaction for a total purchase consideration of approximately $930 million.

J.P. Morgan acted as Alcon’s financial advisor for the transaction, and Alcon’s legal advisor was
Skadden, Arps, Slate, Meagher & Flom LLP. Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC and Lazard acted as Aerie’s
financial advisors for the transaction, and Aerie’s legal advisor was Fried, Frank, Harris, Shriver
& Jacobson LLP.

** About Alcon **

Alcon helps people see brilliantly. As the global leader in eye care with a heritage spanning over
75 years, we offer the broadest portfolio of products to enhance sight and improve people’s lives.
Our Surgical and Vision Care products touch the lives of more than 260 million people in over 140
countries each year living with conditions like cataracts, glaucoma, retinal diseases and refractive
errors. Our more than 24,000 associates are enhancing the quality of life through innovative
products, partnerships with Eye Care Professionals and programs that advance access to quality eye
care. Learn more at [www.alcon.com][24].

# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

# Building a world of health around every individual

We connect people to the care they need, put medicine and wellness within reach, and drive greater
affordability, simplicity and convenience in everything we do.

## Combining our strengths for you

Health services Health insurance Pharmacy Prescription drug coverage

### Health services

We have an unmatched ability to reach people and provide them with access to the affordable, quality
health care and wellbeing services they need to live their healthiest lives.

[Explore our services ][110]

### Health insurance

Aetna® creates insurance plans that deliver a total, connected, affordable approach to health care.

[Discover Aetna plans ][111]

### Pharmacy

Our neighborhood pharmacies — as well as our prescription delivery and specialty medication services
— are making it as easy as possible for people to get the care they depend on.

[Visit our pharmacy page ][112]

### Prescription drug coverage

Our pharmacy benefit manager, CVS Caremark®, plays a critical role in the health care system by
helping to lower drug costs and expand coverage to the affordable medications people need to stay
healthy.

[Learn about drug coverage ][113]

### View transcript

Having 1 kid?...Not exactly simple.

Having 6 kids? Definitely not simple. Wait, that’s 8 people in one family. Whoa.

That means finding ONE tv show they’ll ALL watch.

Making ONE dinner they’ll ALL eat.

And how do you play a board game with 6 kids?…actually, that’s kinda simple.

Okaaay, not so simple.

But it’s not just tantrums.

It’s attitudes.

That’s right. Teenagers.

And how do you decide who gets the last piece of pizza?

But you don’t just have 6 kids, you have 6 kids all with chronic illnesses.

That means on top of it all, you have to manage over 50 prescriptions, medical checkups, and support
everyone’s mental health.

Luckily, you’re not alone…I mean Tricia, obviously YOU’RE not alone.

But you’ve also got CVS Health as your healthcare partner, to manage specialty medications, provide
walk-in appointments, and keep track of it all in the CVS Health app.

So, does that make everything…simple?

No. It makes it simple…er

And sometimes, “simpler” is all you need to live a little happier and healthier.

But who gets the last piece of pizza? That’s still your call.

When you need more than a pharmacy…
CVS Health.
Healthier Happens Together.

**SR 2025 VIDEO**

I am pleased to announce the publication of our 2025 sustainability report. This report highlights
our Sustainability Approach and , and our commitment to Acting Responsibly. For 50 years we've
focused on producing high-quality medicines and contributing to a healthy society. Our aim is to put
better health within reach every day. 

Our approach to sustainability rests on four key pillars, at the center, our core pillar of
advancing health and wellbeing, and in support are our three pillars on empowering our people,
protecting the environment, and operating transparently and ethically. 

In 2025, we created a clear  and coherent access to medicine strategy and introduced a set of
metrics through which we can measure and benchmark our performance. 

Globally, we were able to treat more than 222 million patients, which demonstrates the true impact
of our efforts. 2025 also saw continued work with our communities by providing educational
opportunities, food donations and offering medicines to those most in need. And in total we donated
medicines worth more than $2.6m. Community engagement and social responsibility is something that is
ingrained in our culture, over the course of the year we reached more than 560,000 people through
our community outreach programmes. 

We also continued to support out people. Our recently completed People Voice Survey showed employee
engagement at 73% and employee enablement at 68%. The results will help guide our employee
programmes and help continue to make Hikma a great place to work. 

Throughout 2025, we continued to improve  our environmental performance, focusing specifically on
mitigating our emissions and establishing a more robust approach to water management, particularly
in the water scarce countries where we operate. As an example, we established water stewardship and
absolute CO2 emission reduction KPIs that link directly to Executive remuneration.

We also opened a new 1MW solar park in Jordan, and have plans to go much further in the coming
years.

Finally, we also spent 2025 continuing to focus on ethics and transparency across our value chain,
and taking serious measures to safeguard fundamental human rights both in the upstream and
downstream parts of our business. 

This year, for the first time we asked our key suppliers to rate us on how well we work with them,
and how we uphold our own Code of Conduct.

We believe that our high-quality medicines should reach everyone who needs them . This is why we
focus on acting responsibly, that means advancing health and wellbeing, empowering our people,
protecting the environment, and operating transparently and ethically.

# Health [X] Environment

The Kowa Group is a multinational corporation with a diverse range of businesses, expanding its
business around the world together including US companies.

## Our Business

[Research and Development]

Kowa Health Care US Company, Ltd.

We sell and deliver health care products in the United States including beverages, OTC products to
athletes and consumers. Our hope is that everyone can stay happy and healthy through our products.

[Learn more][8]
[Production/Quality assurance/Safety management]

Kowa Pharmaceuticals America, Inc.

We are committed to continuing the development and commercialization of safe and effective
healthcare solutions for our current and near-term portfolio of pharmaceutical products and business
development activities.

[Learn more][9]
[Research and Development]

Kowa Research Institute, Inc.

We are responsible for the clinical development of Kowa Company’s new drugs and medical devices. The
company is a division of Kowa Company, Ltd. headquartered in Nagoya, Japan. We conduct business in
RTP, NC and Boston, MA.

[Learn more][10]
[Production/Quality assurance/Safety management]

Kowa American Corp. Chemical Division

We are a component of an extensive global distribution network that links the supply and demand for
specialized chemicals on a global scale. Our clients have benefited from a well-balanced product
portfolio that we build with our strong sourcing acumen. In addition, we are happy to help our
clients find the ideal solution.

[Learn more][11]
[Research and Development]

Kowa American Corp. Lifestyle Division

We operate mainly in two areas: the textile business and the brand marketing business. We are
developing our business in a wide range of fields related to textiles, centering on textile
materials, which are the founding business of Kowa, including apparel products, brands, and building
materials.

[Learn more][12]
[Production/Quality assurance/Safety management]

Kowa American Corp. LA Branch

As a manufacturer, Kowa leverages its core optical technology to provide a diverse range of vision
products. From industrial applications and surveillance to personal use and medical devices, we
handle every step from research and development to manufacturing.

[Learn more][13]

# Our Vision

### The new future Kowa aims.

With new innovations emerging one after another, such as generative AI, the digital transformation
has further accelerated in recent years. By enhancing cooperation across existing businesses on the
theme of “Health and Environment” and introducing technologies such as AI, IoT and robots, Kowa
looks to spread digital technologies into our lives to make them richer.
**“Health”**
We are not limited to the research and development of conventional medicines and self-care products;
we are promoting "self-care" to contribute to extending people's healthy lifespans and preventing
diseases. Furthermore, we will contribute to the realization of well-being, i.e., physical, mental,
and social conditions. **“Environment”**
We are proactively working to enhance its environmentally friendly products and services, with an
eye on the SDGs, which are the common goals of the international community, and the international
framework for climate change countermeasures, in order to achieve virtually zero greenhouse gas
emissions. Our environmental business will contribute to the realization of a decarbonized society
by linking each business and promoting the creation of new business models and supply chains that
transcend the boundaries of industries.

# Our Vision

### The new future Kowa aims.

With new innovations emerging one after another, such as generative AI, the digital transformation
has further accelerated in recent years. By enhancing cooperation across existing businesses on the
theme of “Health and Environment” and introducing technologies such as AI, IoT and robots, Kowa
looks to spread digital technologies into our lives to make them richer.
**“Health”**
We are not limited to the research and development of conventional medicines and self-care products;
we are promoting "self-care" to contribute to extending people's healthy lifespans and preventing
diseases. Furthermore, we will contribute to the realization of well-being, i.e., physical, mental,
and social conditions. **“Environment”**
We are proactively working to enhance its environmentally friendly products and services, with an
eye on the SDGs, which are the common goals of the international community, and the international
framework for climate change countermeasures, in order to achieve virtually zero greenhouse gas
emissions. Our environmental business will contribute to the realization of a decarbonized society
by linking each business and promoting the creation of new business models and supply chains that
transcend the boundaries of industries.

your treatment or care. Spark Therapeutics Generation Patient Services^{®} does not provide medical
advice. You should always rely on the direction of your healthcare professional for treatment and
care.

## Indication

LUXTURNA (voretigene neparvovec-rzyl) is a prescription gene therapy product used for the treatment
of patients with inherited retinal disease due to mutations in both copies of the *RPE65* gene,
which can only be confirmed through genetic testing. You must also have enough remaining cells in
your retina (the thin layer of tissue in the back of your eyes) as determined by your healthcare
professional.

## Important Safety Information for LUXTURNA

**The following serious side effects may occur during or after the administration of LUXTURNA:**
* Eye infections, including a serious infection inside of the eye called endophthalmitis, that may
  lead to blindness.
* Permanent decline in visual acuity, or the sharpness of central vision.
* Changes in the retina (the thin layer of tissue in the back of the eye) that can lead to vision
  loss including:
  * development of a hole, thinning, or loss of function of the retina, separation of the layers in
    the center of the retina, loss of retinal cells and the choroid (the layer of blood vessels that
    lines the back of the eye), or bleeding in the retina.
  * breaks in or wrinkling on the surface of the retina or detachment of the retina.
* Increased pressure inside of the eye. You should follow-up with your healthcare professional as
  instructed to detect and treat any increased pressure in the eye as this may cause blindness.

* Changes in the retina (the thin layer of tissue in the back of the eye) that can lead to vision
  loss including:
  * development of a hole, thinning, or loss of function of the retina, separation of the layers in
    the center of the retina, loss of retinal cells and the choroid (the layer of blood vessels that
    lines the back of the eye), or bleeding in the retina.
  * breaks in or wrinkling on the surface of the retina or detachment of the retina.
* Increased pressure inside of the eye. You should follow-up with your healthcare professional as
  instructed to detect and treat any increased pressure in the eye as this may cause blindness.

* Seeing floaters (specks that float about in your field of vision)
* Pain in the eye
* Any change in vision including decreased vision or blurred vision
* Seeing flashes of light

**The following are the most common side effects that may occur with LUXTURNA:**
* Redness of the eye
* Cataract (clouding of the lens inside of the eye)
* Increased pressure inside of the eye
* Breaks in the retina
* Dellen (thinning of the clear layer in the front of the eye)
* Development of a hole in the center of the retina
* Subretinal deposits (deposits under the retina)
* Eye swelling, irritation or pain
* Wrinkling on the surface of the center of the retina

## Smart Therapies for Difficult Diseases^{®}

### Our investigational immunotherapy products are tailored to each patient’s needs. We employ a
### “triangle offense” designed to deliver durable, complete responses in cancer and infectious
### diseases.

[Our Science][51]

At ImmunityBio, we envision a day when we no longer fear cancer, but are able to conquer it, thanks
to the biological wonder that is the human immune system. Our scientists are working to develop
remarkable new therapies that harness that inherent power by amplifying both the innate and adaptive
branches of the immune system, to facilitate the attack and elimination of cancerous or infected
cells today while building immunological memory for tomorrow. The goal: to reprogram the patient’s
immune system and treat the host rather than just the disease.

Dr. Patrick Soon-Shiong
Global Chief Scientific and Medical Officer,
ImmunityBio

## Investigational Immunotherapies

ImmunityBio is developing immunotherapies that activate both innate and adaptive immune responses to
treat cancer and infectious diseases. Our approach stimulates NK cells, T cells, macrophages, and
dendritic cells to create a durable immune response, aiming to outperform treatments like CAR-T or
checkpoint inhibitors.

#### Learn more about our therapeutic areas

[Bladder Cancer][52] [Glioblastoma][53] [Lynch Syndrome][54] [Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma][55] [Non-Small
Cell Lung Cancer][56] [Ovarian Cancer][57] [HIV][58] 

## ImmunityBio is continuously pursuing new immunotherapies designed to attack disease by
## *enhancing* the patient’s immune system, not weakening it.

[About Us][59]

## A Robust Clinical Pipeline

We are applying our science and platforms, including the development of potential cancer vaccines,
to treat cancers, as well as developing immuno- and cell therapies that we believe could sharply
reduce or eliminate the need for standard high-dose chemotherapy.

## The Power of Chasing A Dream

Every day, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives. We apply our deep

## A new company

On March 1, 2019, Singapore-headquartered Sivantos Group joined forces with Lynge/Denmark-based
Widex to form WS Audiology. Please visit [wsa.com][3] for access to all relevant information about
our current company where we strive to unlock human potential by making wonderful sound part of
everyone’s life.

 

Until January 2015, Sivantos Group was a Siemens business unit. That’s when we became an independent
entity. Ever since, Sivantos has worked hard to reshape the industry in terms of innovation with
cutting-edge products, services, and channels. Finally, in 2019, we merged with Widex to continue on
our path as WS Audiology.

While federal biomedical research funding faces uncertainty, BrightFocus Foundation provides
critical support for innovative brain and eye research.
[Read More][125]

# Mission

## Envisioning a world where we all age free from diseases of mind and sight.

BrightFocus Foundation is on a mission to cure Alzheimer’s disease and related dementias and stop
vision loss in its tracks.
[Scientist in a laboratory wearing a white coat and blue gloves, carefully examining a specimen
through a microscope with sample vials and testing materials on the workbench.] [Joshua Emmerson,
PhD working in a lab.] [Happy family enjoying in public park]

## Over 50 Years of Bold Research

We believe that having the courage to invest in innovative ideas will lead to revolutionary
therapies. Explore how the research we’ve funded has fostered life-changing breakthroughs across
Alzheimer’s disease, macular degeneration, and glaucoma.

[Our Impact][126]
[An older woman embraces an older man from behind. They are looking at each other and smiling.]
[a decorative icon]

### 1 in 5

People over age 40 in the U.S. has Alzheimer’s disease, macular degeneration, or glaucoma.

[a decorative icon]

### 186

Active scientific projects funded by BrightFocus worldwide.

[a decorative icon]

### 6,573

Scientists from 25 countries supported by BrightFocus grants working toward cures.

[Resources icon.]

## Resources

### We’re here for you.

Find free resources, virtual information programs, and so much more to help you navigate Alzheimer’s
disease, macular degeneration, and glaucoma.
Glaucoma Chats

## New Frontiers in Glaucoma Research

BrightFocus Foundation’s National Glaucoma Research program recently awarded $2.3 million in new
funding for cutting-edge projects worldwide. BrightFocus’ Director of Vision Science Programs Dr.
Jimmy Liu and Vice President of Scientific Affairs Dr. Diane Bovenkamp discuss the newly funded
research spanning AI, neuroprotection, immune response, early detection, and novel therapies.

## About Dr. Levine

Dr. Richard E. Levine is a board-certified ophthalmologist and surgeon specializing in cataract
surgery, LASIK, glaucoma treatment, and advanced vision correction. As the Medical Director of
Cliffside Laser Eye and Cataract Center, he is known for his patient-focused approach, using
state-of-the-art techniques to deliver expert care in a welcoming environment. With over 25 years of
experience, Dr. Levine has been a leader in refractive cataract surgery, multifocal lens
implantation, and minimally invasive glaucoma procedures. He is dedicated to providing personalized
treatment, ensuring each patient receives the highest level of care for their vision needs.

[Read Full Bio][32]

## Our Services

[Glaucomain-Cliffside-Park-NJ]

###### Glaucoma

Glaucoma can develop without noticeable symptoms and may lead to serious vision loss if untreated.
At Cliffside Laser Eye and Cataract Center, Dr. Richard E. Levine provides glaucoma testing and care
to help detect and manage the condition early.

[Learn More][33]
[Cataracts treated in Cliffside Park NJ]

###### Cataracts

Cataracts cause gradual vision loss, but they can be safely treated to restore clear sight. At
Cliffside Laser Eye and Cataract Center, Dr. Richard E. Levine offers advanced cataract treatment to
help patients see more clearly, often reducing or eliminating the need for glasses.

[Learn More][34]
[LASIK offered in Cliffside Park NJ]

###### LASIK

LASIK is a quick, in-office laser procedure that corrects vision, often reducing or eliminating the
need for glasses or contacts. At Cliffside Laser Eye and Cataract Center, Dr. Richard E. Levine
offers LASIK for eligible patients seeking clearer vision with long-term results.

[Learn More][35]
[Dry-Eyes-in-Cliffside-Park-NJ.]

###### Dry Eyes

Dry eyes can be uncomfortable and may indicate an underlying condition that requires treatment. At
Cliffside Laser Eye and Cataract Center, Dr. Richard E. Levine provides comprehensive exams and
effective treatment options to help relieve persistent dry eye symptoms.

[Learn More][36]
[Eye-Exams offered in Cliffside Park NJ]

###### Eye Exams

Regular eye exams help detect vision problems and eye diseases early, preventing serious
complications. At Cliffside Laser Eye and Cataract Center, Dr. Richard E. Levine provides
comprehensive exams to assess vision, eye health, and conditions like glaucoma.

[Learn More][37]
[Laser-Floater-Removal-in-Cliffside-Park-NJ]

###### Laser Floater Removal

Eye floaters are common with age, but severe cases can interfere with vision and may require
treatment. At Cliffside Laser Eye and Cataract Center, Dr. Richard E. Levine offers laser floater
removal, a less invasive alternative to conventional surgery.

[Learn More][38]

## About Dr. Levine

Dr. Richard E. Levine is a board-certified ophthalmologist and surgeon specializing in cataract
surgery, LASIK, glaucoma treatment, and advanced vision correction. As the Medical Director of
Cliffside Laser Eye and Cataract Center, he is known for his patient-focused approach, using
state-of-the-art techniques to deliver expert care in a welcoming environment. With over 25 years of
experience, Dr. Levine has been a leader in refractive cataract surgery, multifocal lens
implantation, and minimally invasive glaucoma procedures. He is dedicated to providing personalized
treatment, ensuring each patient receives the highest level of care for their vision needs.

[Read Full Bio][32]

## Our Services

[Glaucomain-Cliffside-Park-NJ]

###### Glaucoma

Glaucoma can develop without noticeable symptoms and may lead to serious vision loss if untreated.
At Cliffside Laser Eye and Cataract Center, Dr. Richard E. Levine provides glaucoma testing and care
to help detect and manage the condition early.

[Learn More][33]
[Cataracts treated in Cliffside Park NJ]

###### Cataracts

Cataracts cause gradual vision loss, but they can be safely treated to restore clear sight. At
Cliffside Laser Eye and Cataract Center, Dr. Richard E. Levine offers advanced cataract treatment to
help patients see more clearly, often reducing or eliminating the need for glasses.

[Learn More][34]
[LASIK offered in Cliffside Park NJ]

###### LASIK

LASIK is a quick, in-office laser procedure that corrects vision, often reducing or eliminating the
need for glasses or contacts. At Cliffside Laser Eye and Cataract Center, Dr. Richard E. Levine
offers LASIK for eligible patients seeking clearer vision with long-term results.

[Learn More][35]
[Dry-Eyes-in-Cliffside-Park-NJ.]

###### Dry Eyes

Dry eyes can be uncomfortable and may indicate an underlying condition that requires treatment. At
Cliffside Laser Eye and Cataract Center, Dr. Richard E. Levine provides comprehensive exams and
effective treatment options to help relieve persistent dry eye symptoms.

[Learn More][36]
[Eye-Exams offered in Cliffside Park NJ]

###### Eye Exams

Regular eye exams help detect vision problems and eye diseases early, preventing serious
complications. At Cliffside Laser Eye and Cataract Center, Dr. Richard E. Levine provides
comprehensive exams to assess vision, eye health, and conditions like glaucoma.

[Learn More][37]
[Laser-Floater-Removal-in-Cliffside-Park-NJ]

###### Laser Floater Removal

Eye floaters are common with age, but severe cases can interfere with vision and may require
treatment. At Cliffside Laser Eye and Cataract Center, Dr. Richard E. Levine offers laser floater
removal, a less invasive alternative to conventional surgery.

[Learn More][38]
[Lens-Implants-in-Cliffside-Park-NJ]

###### Lens Implants

Lens implants can improve vision after cataract surgery, with options tailored to different
lifestyles. At Cliffside Laser Eye and Cataract Center, Dr. Richard E. Levine offers monofocal,
monovision, and multifocal implants to help patients achieve their ideal balance of clarity and
independence from glasses.

[Learn More][39]
[Lipiflow-Dry-Eye-Treatment-offered-in-Cliffside-Park-NJ]

###### Lipiflow Dry Eye Treatment

LipiFlow is an advanced treatment for dry eye caused by meibomian gland dysfunction, addressing the
root cause rather than just symptoms. At Cliffside Laser Eye and Cataract Center, Dr. Richard E.
Levine offers this in-office procedure to help restore healthy tear production and long-term relief.

[Learn More][40]

Dräger manufactures medical and safety technology products. In so doing, we protect, support, and
save people's lives around the world in hospitals, with fire departments, emergency services,
authorities, and in mining as well as industry. Founded in Lübeck in 1889, Dräger has grown into a
worldwide, listed enterprise in its fifth generation as a family-run business. Dräger has more than
16,000 employees worldwide and is present in over 190 countries around the globe. In 2023, the
company generated net sales of around EUR 3.4 billion.

### [2026 Nasal & Inhalation Drug Development & Delivery eBook: Drug Repurposing Creates New Market
### Opportunities][16]

In this exclusive seventh annual nasal and inhalation eBook, Drug Development & Delivery highlights
how these routes of administration are bringing new life to orphaned drugs and open new
opportunities for treatment beyond pulmonary and respiratory diseases. We also explore the
challenges of nose-to-brain delivery, next-generation propellants, overcoming the limitations of dry
powder inhalers, and successful formulation strategies.

[Featured Articles][17]

### [SPECIAL FEATURE - Outsourcing Formulation Development & Manufacturing: Connecting Your Project
### to the Right Service Provider][18]

Outsourcing formulation development and manufacturing can help drug developers address complex
dosage forms, scale-up risks, regulatory demands, and accelerated timelines by connecting projects
with CDMO partners that offer specialized expertise, integrated workflows, and scalable
manufacturing support.

[Featured Articles][19]

### [SPECIAL REPORT - Advancements in Respiratory Drug Delivery][20]

Advances in inhaled drug delivery are improving how therapies reach the lungs, with innovations in
formulations, devices, biologics, and digital tools helping expand treatment options for respiratory
diseases.

[Featured Articles][21]

### [CAR T CELL THERAPY - The Rise of Scalable Allogeneic CAR T: Shaping a New Era in Oncology][22]

Allogeneic CAR T therapies are helping move oncology toward more scalable, off-the-shelf treatment
models that could expand access, support earlier intervention, and bring advanced cell therapy
closer to community cancer settings.

[Featured Articles][23]

### [EXECUTIVE INTERVIEW - Dr. Michalis Papadakis Founder & CEO Brainomix][24]

Brainomix founder and CEO Dr. Michalis Papadakis discusses how AI-powered imaging is helping drug
developers improve clinical trial design, identify meaningful treatment effects, and advance new
therapies in stroke, pulmonary fibrosis, and other areas of unmet need.

[Featured Articles][25]

### [DRUG-DEVICE COMBINATION PRODUCTS - Incorporating Self-Administered Drug-Device Combination
### Products Into Clinical Trials Can Bring Outsized Challenges & Outstanding Rewards][26]

Self-administered drug-device combination products can bring major benefits to clinical trials,
improving patient convenience, dosing consistency, compliance, and real-world insight, but they
require careful early planning around usability, safety, regulatory requirements, compatibility,
manufacturing, and scale-up.

[Featured Articles][27]

### [DRUG DELIVERY - Improved Prediction of Food Effect on Oral Absorption][28]

Dissolution-permeation testing is helping drug developers better predict how food affects oral drug
absorption by measuring both drug solubilization and membrane permeation, reducing the risk of
misleading results from dissolution data alone.

[Featured Articles][29]

### [DRUG DEVELOPMENT - Drug Combination Screening in Oncology: Advancing Predictive Strategies for
### Precision Drug Development][30]

Drug combination screening is helping oncology developers identify synergistic drug pairs, connect
response patterns to tumor biology, and support more predictive, biomarker-guided strategies for
precision cancer treatment.

[Featured Articles][31]

### [SINGLE B CELL ANTIBODY DISCOVERY - Improving Therapeutic Candidate Selection in Drug
### Development][32]

Single B cell antibody discovery is helping improve therapeutic candidate selection by preserving
native heavy- and light-chain pairing, accelerating sequence-defined screening, and enabling earlier
identification of candidates with stronger specificity, function, and developability.

[Featured Articles][33]

### [CHEMOENZYMATIC LIGATION - Enabling Scalable, Sustainable Oligonucleotide Manufacturing][34]

Chemoenzymatic ligation offers a scalable, more sustainable path for oligonucleotide manufacturing
by combining SPOS fragment production with enzymatic assembly to improve purity, reduce impurities,
and support growing demand for nucleic acid therapeutics.

[Featured Articles][35]

### [CONTROLLED RELEASE - Precision in Every Dose: Advancing Controlled Release for Small Molecule
### Therapeutics][36]

Controlled release technologies are helping small molecule therapeutics deliver more consistent drug
exposure, improve patient adherence, reduce dosing frequency, and support more precise treatment
through advanced formulation and delivery strategies.

[Featured Articles][37]

### [CAR T CELL THERAPY - The Rise of Scalable Allogeneic CAR T: Shaping a New Era in Oncology][22]

Allogeneic CAR T therapies are helping move oncology toward more scalable, off-the-shelf treatment
models that could expand access, support earlier intervention, and bring advanced cell therapy
closer to community cancer settings.

[Featured Articles][23]

### [EXECUTIVE INTERVIEW - Dr. Michalis Papadakis Founder & CEO Brainomix][24]

Brainomix founder and CEO Dr. Michalis Papadakis discusses how AI-powered imaging is helping drug
developers improve clinical trial design, identify meaningful treatment effects, and advance new
therapies in stroke, pulmonary fibrosis, and other areas of unmet need.

[Featured Articles][25]

### [DRUG-DEVICE COMBINATION PRODUCTS - Incorporating Self-Administered Drug-Device Combination
### Products Into Clinical Trials Can Bring Outsized Challenges & Outstanding Rewards][26]

Self-administered drug-device combination products can bring major benefits to clinical trials,
improving patient convenience, dosing consistency, compliance, and real-world insight, but they
require careful early planning around usability, safety, regulatory requirements, compatibility,
manufacturing, and scale-up.

[Featured Articles][27]

### [DRUG DELIVERY - Improved Prediction of Food Effect on Oral Absorption][28]

Dissolution-permeation testing is helping drug developers better predict how food affects oral drug
absorption by measuring both drug solubilization and membrane permeation, reducing the risk of
misleading results from dissolution data alone.

[Featured Articles][29]

### [DRUG DEVELOPMENT - Drug Combination Screening in Oncology: Advancing Predictive Strategies for
### Precision Drug Development][30]

Drug combination screening is helping oncology developers identify synergistic drug pairs, connect
response patterns to tumor biology, and support more predictive, biomarker-guided strategies for
precision cancer treatment.

[Featured Articles][31]

### [SINGLE B CELL ANTIBODY DISCOVERY - Improving Therapeutic Candidate Selection in Drug
### Development][32]

Single B cell antibody discovery is helping improve therapeutic candidate selection by preserving
native heavy- and light-chain pairing, accelerating sequence-defined screening, and enabling earlier
identification of candidates with stronger specificity, function, and developability.

[Featured Articles][33]

### [CHEMOENZYMATIC LIGATION - Enabling Scalable, Sustainable Oligonucleotide Manufacturing][34]

Chemoenzymatic ligation offers a scalable, more sustainable path for oligonucleotide manufacturing
by combining SPOS fragment production with enzymatic assembly to improve purity, reduce impurities,
and support growing demand for nucleic acid therapeutics.

[Featured Articles][35]

### [CONTROLLED RELEASE - Precision in Every Dose: Advancing Controlled Release for Small Molecule
### Therapeutics][36]

Controlled release technologies are helping small molecule therapeutics deliver more consistent drug
exposure, improve patient adherence, reduce dosing frequency, and support more precise treatment
through advanced formulation and delivery strategies.

[Featured Articles][37]

### [BIOCATALYSIS - Biocatalysis Without Barriers for Efficient Small Molecule Process
### Development][38]

Masha Kononov and Reuben Carr examine both the promise and the practical constraints of biocatalysis
in modern drug substance development, as well as the role of contract research, development and
manufacturing organizations (CRD-MOs) in meeting the evolving demands of modern small molecule
synthesis.

[Contract Services,][39] [Featured Articles][40]

### [SPECIAL FEATURE - PFS & Parenteral Manufacturing: Rapid Growth of Injectables Places
### Unprecedented Demands on Parenteral Manufacturing][41]

Contributor Cindy H. Dubin highlights many of these CDMOs as well as innovations in the PFS sector.

[Contract Services,][42] [Featured Articles][43]

### [FORMULATION FORUM - Supercritical Carbon Dioxide (scCO2) for Improving Solubility & Oral
### Bioavailability of Drugs][44]

Shaukat Ali, PhD, and Jim Huang, PhD, discuss as more new chemical entities coming out of discovery
are poorly soluble (BCS Class II and IV), the scCO2 is taking an aim to find the desired solutions
to help improve the bottleneck in the industry.

[Featured Articles][45]

### [TKIS - Next-Generation BCR-ABL TKIs for CML: The Allosteric Era][46]

Emil Kuriakose, MD, explores the current CML treatment landscape, ongoing clinical challenges, and
the potential of next-generation TKIs currently in development, offering hope for the growing CML
community.

### Frequently Asked Questions
1. Do fake designer sunglasses protect your eyes?
   
   Fake designer sunglasses often provide no protection against dangerous UV rays and could mean
   putting yourself at risk of developing serious eye conditions, such as cataract and macular
   degeneration which can lead to sight loss. Children are particularly susceptible to UV rays and
   should have their eyes protected even in lower UV conditions.
   
   You don’t need to buy expensive sunglasses to get the necessary protection. A budget pair of
   sunglasses from a reputable high street shop can offer as much UV protection as a designer brand.
   Your local [optometry practice][23] is also a great place to go if you need advice on the health
   of your eyes, and to find the perfect pair of fitted sunglasses.
   
   To make sure you have the necessary protection for your eyes, purchase sunglasses that have the
   UV mark, either the British Standard (BS EN ISO 12312-1:2013), CE or UKCA mark.
   
   [Read more about summer eye health][24]
2. What are floaters?
   
   Floaters are small dark or transparent dots or strands or something that looks like a hair or
   small pieces of a cobweb that float in the vitreous gel inside your eye. They are formed when the
   vitreous, which is the jelly inside your eye, separates into watery fluid and wavy collagen
   fibres. They appear to float in front of your eyes and move when you try to look at them. They
   are very common and are normally harmless.
   
   [Read more about floaters.][25]
3. What is long-sightedness (hyperopia)?
   
   Normally, light is focussed by the cornea and lens to form a sharp image on the retina.
   Long-sightedness occurs when the eyeball is slightly too short so that the focus point is behind
   the retina at the back of the eye. If you are long-sighted, you find it more difficult to see
   clearly objects that are close to you. For example, words on a page or your phone screen may seem
   blurred.
   
   [Read more about long-sightedness.][26]

#### Learn more about your eye condition and how LUCENTIS may be able to help.
#### Over 12 million doses have been given since 2006.

LUCENTIS^{®} (ranibizumab), a [VEGF inhibitor][15], treats [wet age-related macular
degeneration][16] (wAMD), [diabetic macular edema (DME) and diabetic retinopathy (DR)][17], [macular
edema following retinal vein occlusion][18] (RVO), and [myopic choroidal neovascularization][19]
(mCNV).

LUCENTIS is designed to block vascular endothelial (VASS‐cue‐ler end‐oh‐THEEL‐e‐ull) growth factor,
or [VEGF][20] (vej‐EFF), from inside the eye. This may help reduce unhealthy swelling, leaking, and
growth of blood vessels, which helps maintain vision.

Lucentis is administered via [intravitreal injection][21] into the eye, typically performed monthly
or as advised by your healthcare provider. 

Serious risks such as infections, retinal detachments, or arterial thromboembolic events (ATEs) are
rare. Monitoring intraocular pressure before and after treatment is essential. Seek immediate care
if any severe vision changes or signs of infection occur.

Common [side effects of LUCENTIS][22] include conjunctival hemorrhage, eye pain, vitreous floaters,
and intraocular pressure (IOP). Some individuals may also experience redness or discomfort after the
injection.

#### Important Safety Information

Back to Top

**Who is LUCENTIS for?** LUCENTIS^{®} (ranibizumab injection) is a prescription medicine for the
treatment of patients with:
* wet age-related macular degeneration (wAMD)
* macular edema following retinal vein occlusion (RVO)
* diabetic macular edema (DME)
* diabetic retinopathy (DR)
* myopic choroidal neovascularization (mCNV)

**What important safety information should I know about LUCENTIS?** You should not use LUCENTIS if
you have an infection in or around the eye or are allergic to LUCENTIS or any of its ingredients.
LUCENTIS is a prescription medication given by injection into the eye, and it has side effects. Some
LUCENTIS patients have had detached retinas and serious eye infections. If your eye becomes red,
sensitive to light, or painful, or if you have a change in vision, call or visit your eye doctor
right away.

Some LUCENTIS patients have had increases in eye pressure before and within 1 hour of an injection.

Uncommonly, LUCENTIS patients have had serious, sometimes fatal, problems related to blood clots,
such as heart attacks or strokes. Fatal events were seen more often in patients with DME and DR with
LUCENTIS compared with patients who did not receive LUCENTIS. Although there were only few fatal
events which included causes of death typical of patients with advanced diabetic complications,
these events may be caused by LUCENTIS.

Severe inflammation of vessels in the retina has happened for patients treated with LUCENTIS. Call
your healthcare provider immediately if you experience a change in vision.

Some LUCENTIS patients have serious side effects related to the injection. These include serious
infections inside the eye, detached retinas, and cataracts. The most common eye-related side effects
are increased redness in the white of the eye, eye pain, small specks in vision, and increased eye
pressure. The most common non–eye-related side effects are nose and throat infections, anemia,
nausea and cough. Ask your doctor if you have questions or want more information.

You may report side effects to the FDA at (800) FDA-1088 or [www.fda.gov/medwatch][23]. You may also
report side effects to Genentech at (888) 835-2555.

**For additional Safety Information, please talk to your doctor and see the [LUCENTIS full
Prescribing Information][24].**

## How can we help you?

In all our years of serving Texans, Mann Eye Institute has built a reputation that generations of
families have come to trust. From routine eye exams and glasses and contacts to advanced LASIK,
modern cataract surgery and the latest advancements in diagnosing and treating eye diseases, Mann
Eye Institute can expertly care for every member of your family.

## Advanced LASIK

What could your life be like if you didn’t have the hassles of glasses and contacts? Can you see it?
One less restriction. One less inconvenience. One less thing to worry about. Talk to our team to
discover what visual freedom could do for you!

[Learn about Advanced LASIK][52]

## Laser Cataract Surgery

More than two million men and women undergo cataract surgery every year, making it one of the most
common and successful medical procedures in the U.S. today. And laser cataract surgery represents
one of the great surgical advancements of our time, offering additional safety, precision and
consistency of results.

[Learn about Laser Cataract Surgery][53]

## Reading Vision Correction

If you’ve lost the crisp, clear vision of your youth, you may be tempted to think you’ll spend the
rest of your days dependent on reading glasses to see things like menus, books, food labels and text
on your phone. Think again! We have several options to address and correct your reading vision woes.

[Learn about Reading Vision Correction][54]

## Refractive Lens Exchange

Refractive Lens Exchange is a customizable vision correction solution that has helped so many people

## How can we help you?

In all our years of serving Texans, Mann Eye Institute has built a reputation that generations of
families have come to trust. From routine eye exams and glasses and contacts to advanced LASIK,
modern cataract surgery and the latest advancements in diagnosing and treating eye diseases, Mann
Eye Institute can expertly care for every member of your family.

[Learn About Our Services][51]

## Advanced LASIK

What could your life be like if you didn’t have the hassles of glasses and contacts? Can you see it?
One less restriction. One less inconvenience. One less thing to worry about. Talk to our team to
discover what visual freedom could do for you!

[Learn about Advanced LASIK][52]

## Laser Cataract Surgery

More than two million men and women undergo cataract surgery every year, making it one of the most
common and successful medical procedures in the U.S. today. And laser cataract surgery represents
one of the great surgical advancements of our time, offering additional safety, precision and
consistency of results.

[Learn about Laser Cataract Surgery][53]

## Reading Vision Correction

If you’ve lost the crisp, clear vision of your youth, you may be tempted to think you’ll spend the
rest of your days dependent on reading glasses to see things like menus, books, food labels and text
on your phone. Think again! We have several options to address and correct your reading vision woes.

[Learn about Reading Vision Correction][54]

## Refractive Lens Exchange

Refractive Lens Exchange is a customizable vision correction solution that has helped so many people
just like you to see clearly with reduced dependency on glasses, contacts and even readers.

[Learn about Refractive Lens Exchange][55]

## Dry Eye

Dry Eye is more common today than ever before. And while your issue could be allergy-related,
experts agree that screen time (things like computers, smartphones, video gaming) is likely to blame
for dry eye symptoms in many cases. But just because it’s common doesn’t mean you have to live with
it!

[Learn about Dry Eye Treatment][56]

Glaucoma, known as the silent thief of sight, is one of the leading causes of blindness in the world
today. It often comes with no symptoms – especially in early stages. Early detection is key! 

[Learn about Glacuoma Treatment][57]

Since the cornea is responsible for much of your eye’s focusing power, it’s important to see an
experienced cornea expert with any corneal concerns.

[Learn about Cornea Treatment][58]

## Treatment of Retina Conditions

There are a number of conditions that affect the retina and need to be diagnosed and treated by an
experienced retina specialist who has additional training and expertise in this area. From diabetic
retinopathy and macular degeneration to retinal detachments and even flashes and floaters, we have
you covered.

[Learn about Retina Condition Treatments][59]

## General Eye Care

Many eye diseases and conditions have no early warning signs. An annual comprehensive eye exam
allows for early detection of vision problems such as macular degeneration, diabetic eye changes,
glaucoma and more. Regular eye examinations are the best safeguard for maintaining good vision at
any stage of life.

[Learn about General Eye Care][60]

## Myopia Management

The topic of myopia (nearsightedness) is more important than ever as the number of people affected
all around the world is on the rise. At Mann Eye Institute, we are leaders in the management of
Myopic Progression (where the nearsightedness gets worse year over year).

[Learn about Myopia Management][61]

## Glasses & Contacts

Whether it’s new stylish frames, the latest in contact lenses or an annual eye exam you’re needing,
you’ve come to the right place! We have been Texas’ leading eye care professionals since 1977. Get
ready to See Life Better!

[Learn about Eye Glasses and Contacts][62]

## Cosmetic Services

Not looking as young as you feel when you look in the mirror? We understand. Signs of aging often
show first around the eyes. We offer comprehensive surgical and non-surgical facial cosmetic
services to help you feel confident and beautiful.  

[Learn about Cosmetic Services][63]

# Welcome to North Fulton Eye Center & Cumming Eye Clinic

Our Ophthalmology practice is an independent, physician-owned practice, providing truly personalized
care that larger corporate practices often cannot match. This independence affords us the
opportunity to spend ample time with each patient and personally oversee every pre- and
post-operative visit, ensuring continuity and a trusted relationship at every step of your
comprehensive care. Proudly serving Fulton County and Forsyth County since 1984.

## Dr. Susanne Hewitt

## Dr. Susanne Hewitt

Dr. Susanne Hewitt is a board certified and fellowship trained Ophthalmologist who specializes in
cataract surgery, refractive surgery including LASIK and PRK, corneal transplantation, and
management of complex corneal disease. A native of Florida, Dr. Hewitt has been serving patients in
the Roswell, Alpharetta, and Cumming area for over 15 years.

[ Read More About Dr. Susanne Hewitt ][77]

## Dr. Lauren Snellings

Dr. Lauren (Lexie) Snellings is an ophthalmologist specializing in laser assisted cataract surgery
and comprehensive eye care. She provides medical treatment for a wide range of conditions, including
dry eye syndrome, glaucoma, diabetic retinopathy, macular degeneration, and more.

[ Read More About Dr. Lauren Snellings ][78]

## Dr. Hannah Park

## Dr. Hannah Park

Dr. Park is a board certified Ophthalmologist who specializes in cataract surgery as well as
comprehensive eye care. She offers advanced intraocular lens technologies for cataract surgery,
including toric (astigmatism correcting), multifocal, and extended depth of focus lenses. Dr. Park
performs femtosecond laser assisted cataract surgery and Microincisional Glaucoma Surgery (MIGS) for
those who are candidates.

For nearly 40 years, our Ophthalmology practice in Roswell and Cumming, Georgia, has built a

seeking expert care in cataract surgery with premium intraocular lenses, glaucoma treatment, cornea
transplants, dry eye management, astigmatism correction, LASIK surgery, or any other treatment, our
team of highly skilled Ophthalmologists is here to help.

What sets our practice apart is our commitment to personalized care in a private practice setting.
We know that each patient has unique needs, and we ensure that your eye care experience is tailored
for your utmost comfort, satisfaction, and exceptional outcomes.

Our Ophthalmology practice is an independent, physician-owned practice, providing truly personalized
care that larger corporate practices often cannot match. This independence affords us the
opportunity to spend ample time with each patient and personally oversee every pre- and
post-operative visit, ensuring continuity and a trusted relationship at every step of your
comprehensive care. Proudly serving Fulton County and Forsyth County since 1984.

## Dr. Susanne Hewitt

## Dr. Susanne Hewitt

Dr. Susanne Hewitt is a board certified and fellowship trained Ophthalmologist who specializes in
cataract surgery, refractive surgery including LASIK and PRK, corneal transplantation, and
management of complex corneal disease. A native of Florida, Dr. Hewitt has been serving patients in
the Roswell, Alpharetta, and Cumming area for over 15 years.

## Dr. Lauren Snellings

## Dr. Hannah Park

Dr. Park is a board certified Ophthalmologist who specializes in cataract surgery as well as
comprehensive eye care. She offers advanced intraocular lens technologies for cataract surgery,

those who are candidates.

## Cosmetic & Oculoplastic Services

North Georgia Eye Associates offers the latest in surgical and non-surgical treatments to help you
look and feel your very best, including skincare products, injectables, non-injectables and laser
treatments. Oculoplastic procedures combine the accuracy and precision found in ophthalmic surgeries
with the aesthetic foundations of plastic surgery.

[Learn More][89]
[Happy couple outside]

### Advanced Technology

## LASIK

Laser-assisted in-situ Keratomileusis (LASIK) is an FDA-approved vision correction procedure that
corrects refractive errors. These include nearsightedness, farsightedness, and astigmatism. It is
performed on nearly 1 million patients annually to help reduce dependency on visual aids and provide
visual freedom. LASIK works because it permanently reshapes the cornea using an excimer and
femtosecond laser.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is an IV Drip Lounge?
An IV drip lounge is a wellness space where licensed medical professionals administer hydration,
vitamins, and targeted infusions designed around your needs.
What is an IV Drip Bar?
It is another name for an IV therapy location that offers hydration and nutrient infusions in a
comfortable, service-focused setting.
Are IV Drips Safe?
When administered by qualified clinicians after an appropriate health review, IV drips are designed
to be a safe and supervised wellness treatment.
What IV is best for me?
The best option depends on your goals, health history, and symptoms. A quick consult helps determine
the most appropriate treatment plan.
Why Is My IV Drip So Slow?
Flow rate can vary based on the infusion type, your comfort, hydration level, and what your provider
recommends for a safe treatment.

### Age-Related Macular Degeneration (AMD)

### Clinician Scientific and Educational Resources

AMD can cause profound impairments to central vision; however, early recognition and prompt
treatment of exudative disease can potentially stabilize or reverse vision loss. Staying current
with the latest information on presentation, prognosis, monitoring, and treatment advances is
critical for ensuring optimal vision health in people with AMD.

Learn more about AMD pathophysiology and pearls of assessment of atrophic (“dry”) and neovascular
(“wet”) AMD, as well as available treatment strategies, patient education, and clinical trial
resources, by exploring different topics within the portal. High-definition animations, apps, and
other tools for your mobile phone about AMD, related symptoms, and treatment can be found in HD
Visual Learning.

## Navigate change. Decode demand. Grow with confidence.

Markets are changing faster than most planning cycles. Technology, regulation, supply chain shocks
and shifting customer expectations are rewriting the rules across every sector.

Strategic Revenue Insights gives leaders a clear view of where demand is heading, how value pools
are shifting and which bets matter most. We combine rigorous research with practical advisory so
your next move is grounded in evidence, not instinct.

We connect market signals to revenue decisions through a simple, repeatable flow.

## Market Sizing and Forecasting

Strategic Revenue Insights delivers precise market sizing and forecasting that cut through
uncertainty and reveal measurable opportunity. Using rigorous data, cross-industry expertise, and
scenario-based models, we help organizations understand market potential, anticipate shifts, and
make confident strategic decisions grounded in evidence, clarity, and forward-looking intelligence.

Robust models that quantify market size, growth and segment level outlook over five to ten years. We
stress test scenarios against macro assumptions, regulation and technology adoption.

Our Competitive & Benchmarking Analysis gives leaders a clear, evidence-backed understanding of
where they stand in the market, how competitors are shifting their strategies, and which
capabilities drive advantage. We decode competitor moves, benchmark performance across multiple
lenses, and deliver actionable guidance that strengthens positioning and informs confident,
forward-looking decisions.

Clear views of how incumbents and disruptors are positioned. We map portfolios, pricing, innovation
focus, channel strategies and financial performance to show where you stand and where gaps exist.

# AMD Genetic Testing

Age-Related Macular Degeneration (AMD) affects 20 million Americans. 70% of the cause of AMD is due
to genetics. **Visible Genomics’ **[**AMD genetic testing**][36]** can help you better understand
your risk of macular degeneration and plan effective treatment.**

[ What Is AMD ][37]

## Macular Degeneration Genetic Tests By Visible Genomics

[
][39]

AMDiGuard DNA Risk Test

The AMDiGuard Risk Test is designed to use DNA through a simple swab combined with patients’ basic
health factors and provide a risk level of aged-related macular degeneration based on our scientific
analysis of both factors.

[
][40]

AMDiGuard DNA Progression Test

The AMDiGuard Progression Test is designed to learn more about the risk of advanced AMD for patients
who have early to intermediate AMD.

###   Find A Doctor Near You

### Find a doctor in your area using DNA-based macular degeneration genetic testing to care for your

[ Take A Quiz ][42]
 
 
 

### What is AMD

[Macular Degeneration][43] is a progressive and degenerative disease affecting the central part of
the retina, the macula. It is the leading cause of irreversible vision loss in the United States.
Its prevalence is increasing with the growth of our aging population. In the U.S., over 11 million
people suffer from AMD (1.75 million individuals have advanced forms of AMD). One question
consistently asked is if Macular Degeneration is hereditary? 70% of the cause of AMD is due to
genetics. To learn more and see how we can help, [click here][44].

### Physicians: Integrate AMD Genetic Testing Into Your AMD Protocol

**The Time Is Now.** Incorporating a hereditary [AMD genetic testing][45] that provides
comprehensive [risk assessment][46] to provide advanced awareness of disease risk will:
* Empower the patient and physician to make informed clinical and lifestyle decisions together
* Help slow or prevent disease
* Provide greater access to more patients through affordable, easy, and understandable genetic risk
  testing
* Deliver personalized preventative medicine

To learn more on how to begin utilizing the AMDiGuard [genetic macular degeneration tests][47],
[click here.][48]

### About Us

We have a healthy dissatisfaction with the status quo and the current pace of change in the
industry. So we’ve combined our decades of experience in AMD Genetic Testing with the highest
ethical standards to develop [macular degeneration genetic testing][49] capabilities that open a
window of knowledge into your eye health. To learn about our hereditary [AMD genetic tests][50], our
company, and our team, [click here][51].

[ Get Tested ][52]

“Visible Genomics has been a great addition to our practice. It allows us to customize our treatment
and monitoring plan for each of our patients, with current macular degeneration, as well as those
who have family history, and risk factors for the disease. Ordering the genetic testing is easy,
efficient, and the results are easy to interpret and discuss with our patients. Mike has been very
helpful integrating the testing within our office and is always ready to help if we run into any
issues. There is no lack of communication when it comes to streamlining the testing process, and we
are very happy with the results. Thank you Visible Genomics!”

**Dan C. Thieme, O.D., **Meridian Family Eyecare, Meridian, ID

“We have used genetic testing in our office since 2018. Visible Genomics is a step forward which
looks at not only genetic factors, but other essential elements that contribute to our patients'

### What is AMD

[Macular Degeneration][43] is a progressive and degenerative disease affecting the central part of
the retina, the macula. It is the leading cause of irreversible vision loss in the United States.
Its prevalence is increasing with the growth of our aging population. In the U.S., over 11 million
people suffer from AMD (1.75 million individuals have advanced forms of AMD). One question
consistently asked is if Macular Degeneration is hereditary? 70% of the cause of AMD is due to
genetics. To learn more and see how we can help, [click here][44].

**The Time Is Now.** Incorporating a hereditary [AMD genetic testing][45] that provides

## Alcon Completes Acquisition of Aerie Pharmaceuticals, Inc., Strengthening Company’s Ophthalmic
## Pharmaceutical Business

[Print][23]
* **Leveraging Alcon’s robust commercial capabilities and resources to drive further growth and
  access to Rocklatan^{ }and Rhopressa**
* **Acquisition adds pharmaceutical research and development capabilities and further expertise for
  future product pipeline**
* **Expands Alcon’s presence in the $20 billion global ophthalmic pharmaceutical category¹**

GENEVA--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Alcon (SIX/NYSE: ALC), the global leader in eye care dedicated to helping
people see brilliantly, today announced that it has completed its acquisition of Aerie
Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (NASDAQ: AERI, “Aerie”). This transaction helps bolster Alcon’s presence in
the ophthalmic pharmaceutical space with its growing portfolio of commercial products and
development pipeline.

“As we welcome the Aerie team to Alcon, we look forward to leveraging our expanding commercial
footprint and expertise to bring Rocklatan^{®} and Rhopressa^{®} to even more customers and their
patients,” said David Endicott, CEO of Alcon. “Alcon has a rich history in the ophthalmic
pharmaceutical space rooted in a deep understanding of Eye Care Professionals. We are excited to add
Aerie’s significant technical expertise to Alcon R&D, which enhances our efforts to build a
compelling portfolio of ophthalmic pharmaceuticals.”

Through the transaction, Alcon has added the commercial products Rocklatan^{}(netarsudil and
latanoprost ophthalmic solution) 0.02%/0.005% and Rhopressa^{}(netarsudil ophthalmic solution)
0.02%, as well as AR-15512, a Phase 3 product candidate for dry eye disease. Alcon has also acquired
a pipeline of ophthalmic pharmaceutical product candidates with the opportunity to leverage Aerie’s
existing research and development capabilities.

The transaction complements Alcon’s expansion intothe ophthalmic pharmaceutical space, including
acquisitions of the exclusive U.S. commercialization rights for Simbrinza^{® }from Novartis in April
2021 and Eysuvis^{®} and Inveltys^{®} from Kala Pharmaceuticals, Inc. in May 2022.

Alcon intends to fully integrate Aerie into its business. As previously disclosed, the Company has
used debt to fund the transaction for a total purchase consideration of approximately $930 million.

J.P. Morgan acted as Alcon’s financial advisor for the transaction, and Alcon’s legal advisor was
Skadden, Arps, Slate, Meagher & Flom LLP. Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC and Lazard acted as Aerie’s
financial advisors for the transaction, and Aerie’s legal advisor was Fried, Frank, Harris, Shriver
& Jacobson LLP.

** About Alcon **

Alcon helps people see brilliantly. As the global leader in eye care with a heritage spanning over
75 years, we offer the broadest portfolio of products to enhance sight and improve people’s lives.
Our Surgical and Vision Care products touch the lives of more than 260 million people in over 140
countries each year living with conditions like cataracts, glaucoma, retinal diseases and refractive
errors. Our more than 24,000 associates are enhancing the quality of life through innovative
products, partnerships with Eye Care Professionals and programs that advance access to quality eye
care. Learn more at [www.alcon.com][24].

# Better health. Within reach. Every day.

As a global pharmaceutical company, at Hikma we are creating high-quality products and making them
accessible to those who need them, helping to shape a healthier world that enriches all our
communities.

[ Who we are ][82]
Play video
Transcript

**SR 2025 VIDEO**

I am pleased to announce the publication of our 2025 sustainability report. This report highlights
our Sustainability Approach and , and our commitment to Acting Responsibly. For 50 years we've
focused on producing high-quality medicines and contributing to a healthy society. Our aim is to put
better health within reach every day. 

Our approach to sustainability rests on four key pillars, at the center, our core pillar of
advancing health and wellbeing, and in support are our three pillars on empowering our people,
protecting the environment, and operating transparently and ethically. 

In 2025, we created a clear  and coherent access to medicine strategy and introduced a set of
metrics through which we can measure and benchmark our performance. 

Globally, we were able to treat more than 222 million patients, which demonstrates the true impact
of our efforts. 2025 also saw continued work with our communities by providing educational
opportunities, food donations and offering medicines to those most in need. And in total we donated
medicines worth more than $2.6m. Community engagement and social responsibility is something that is
ingrained in our culture, over the course of the year we reached more than 560,000 people through
our community outreach programmes. 

We also continued to support out people. Our recently completed People Voice Survey showed employee
engagement at 73% and employee enablement at 68%. The results will help guide our employee
programmes and help continue to make Hikma a great place to work. Skip to content

[ Who we are ][82]
Play video
Transcript

**SR 2025 VIDEO**

I am pleased to announce the publication of our 2025 sustainability report. This report highlights
our Sustainability Approach and , and our commitment to Acting Responsibly. For 50 years we've
focused on producing high-quality medicines and contributing to a healthy society. Our aim is to put
better health within reach every day. 

Our approach to sustainability rests on four key pillars, at the center, our core pillar of

ingrained in our culture, over the course of the year we reached more than 560,000 people through
our community outreach programmes. 

We also continued to support out people. Our recently completed People Voice Survey showed employee
engagement at 73% and employee enablement at 68%. The results will help guide our employee
programmes and help continue to make Hikma a great place to work. 

Throughout 2025, we continued to improve  our environmental performance, focusing specifically on
mitigating our emissions and establishing a more robust approach to water management, particularly
in the water scarce countries where we operate. As an example, we established water stewardship and
absolute CO2 emission reduction KPIs that link directly to Executive remuneration.

We also opened a new 1MW solar park in Jordan, and have plans to go much further in the coming
years.

Finally, we also spent 2025 continuing to focus on ethics and transparency across our value chain,
and taking serious measures to safeguard fundamental human rights both in the upstream and

# Health [X] Environment

The Kowa Group is a multinational corporation with a diverse range of businesses, expanding its
business around the world together including US companies.

## Our Business

[Research and Development]

Kowa Health Care US Company, Ltd.

We sell and deliver health care products in the United States including beverages, OTC products to
athletes and consumers. Our hope is that everyone can stay happy and healthy through our products.

[Learn more][8]
[Production/Quality assurance/Safety management]

Kowa Pharmaceuticals America, Inc.

We are committed to continuing the development and commercialization of safe and effective
healthcare solutions for our current and near-term portfolio of pharmaceutical products and business
development activities.

[Learn more][9]
[Research and Development]

Kowa Research Institute, Inc.

We are responsible for the clinical development of Kowa Company’s new drugs and medical devices. The
company is a division of Kowa Company, Ltd. headquartered in Nagoya, Japan. We conduct business in
RTP, NC and Boston, MA.

[Learn more][10]
[Production/Quality assurance/Safety management]

Kowa American Corp. Chemical Division

We are a component of an extensive global distribution network that links the supply and demand for
specialized chemicals on a global scale. Our clients have benefited from a well-balanced product
portfolio that we build with our strong sourcing acumen. In addition, we are happy to help our
clients find the ideal solution.

[Learn more][11]
[Research and Development]

Kowa American Corp. Lifestyle Division

We operate mainly in two areas: the textile business and the brand marketing business. We are
developing our business in a wide range of fields related to textiles, centering on textile
materials, which are the founding business of Kowa, including apparel products, brands, and building
materials.

[Learn more][12]
[Production/Quality assurance/Safety management]

Kowa American Corp. LA Branch

As a manufacturer, Kowa leverages its core optical technology to provide a diverse range of vision
products. From industrial applications and surveillance to personal use and medical devices, we
handle every step from research and development to manufacturing.

[Learn more][13]

# Our Vision

### The new future Kowa aims.

With new innovations emerging one after another, such as generative AI, the digital transformation
has further accelerated in recent years. By enhancing cooperation across existing businesses on the
theme of “Health and Environment” and introducing technologies such as AI, IoT and robots, Kowa
looks to spread digital technologies into our lives to make them richer.
**“Health”**
We are not limited to the research and development of conventional medicines and self-care products;
we are promoting "self-care" to contribute to extending people's healthy lifespans and preventing
diseases. Furthermore, we will contribute to the realization of well-being, i.e., physical, mental,
and social conditions. **“Environment”**
We are proactively working to enhance its environmentally friendly products and services, with an
eye on the SDGs, which are the common goals of the international community, and the international
framework for climate change countermeasures, in order to achieve virtually zero greenhouse gas
emissions. Our environmental business will contribute to the realization of a decarbonized society
by linking each business and promoting the creation of new business models and supply chains that
transcend the boundaries of industries.

## Smart Therapies for Difficult Diseases^{®}

### Our investigational immunotherapy products are tailored to each patient’s needs. We employ a
### “triangle offense” designed to deliver durable, complete responses in cancer and infectious

[Our Science][51]

At ImmunityBio, we envision a day when we no longer fear cancer, but are able to conquer it, thanks
to the biological wonder that is the human immune system. Our scientists are working to develop
remarkable new therapies that harness that inherent power by amplifying both the innate and adaptive
branches of the immune system, to facilitate the attack and elimination of cancerous or infected
cells today while building immunological memory for tomorrow. The goal: to reprogram the patient’s
immune system and treat the host rather than just the disease.

Dr. Patrick Soon-Shiong
Global Chief Scientific and Medical Officer,
ImmunityBio

## Investigational Immunotherapies

ImmunityBio is developing immunotherapies that activate both innate and adaptive immune responses to
treat cancer and infectious diseases. Our approach stimulates NK cells, T cells, macrophages, and
dendritic cells to create a durable immune response, aiming to outperform treatments like CAR-T or
checkpoint inhibitors.
