## Smart Therapies for Difficult Diseases^{®}

### Our investigational immunotherapy products are tailored to each patient’s needs. We employ a
### “triangle offense” designed to deliver durable, complete responses in cancer and infectious
### diseases.

[Our Science][51]

At ImmunityBio, we envision a day when we no longer fear cancer, but are able to conquer it, thanks
to the biological wonder that is the human immune system. Our scientists are working to develop
remarkable new therapies that harness that inherent power by amplifying both the innate and adaptive
branches of the immune system, to facilitate the attack and elimination of cancerous or infected
cells today while building immunological memory for tomorrow. The goal: to reprogram the patient’s
immune system and treat the host rather than just the disease.

Dr. Patrick Soon-Shiong
Global Chief Scientific and Medical Officer,
ImmunityBio

## Investigational Immunotherapies

ImmunityBio is developing immunotherapies that activate both innate and adaptive immune responses to
treat cancer and infectious diseases. Our approach stimulates NK cells, T cells, macrophages, and
dendritic cells to create a durable immune response, aiming to outperform treatments like CAR-T or
checkpoint inhibitors.

#### Learn more about our therapeutic areas

[Bladder Cancer][52] [Glioblastoma][53] [Lynch Syndrome][54] [Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma][55] [Non-Small
Cell Lung Cancer][56] [Ovarian Cancer][57] [HIV][58] 

## ImmunityBio is continuously pursuing new immunotherapies designed to attack disease by
## *enhancing* the patient’s immune system, not weakening it.

[About Us][59]

## A Robust Clinical Pipeline

We are applying our science and platforms, including the development of potential cancer vaccines,
to treat cancers, as well as developing immuno- and cell therapies that we believe could sharply
reduce or eliminate the need for standard high-dose chemotherapy.

## 30 years

## About Dr. Levine

Dr. Richard E. Levine is a board-certified ophthalmologist and surgeon specializing in cataract
surgery, LASIK, glaucoma treatment, and advanced vision correction. As the Medical Director of
Cliffside Laser Eye and Cataract Center, he is known for his patient-focused approach, using
state-of-the-art techniques to deliver expert care in a welcoming environment. With over 25 years of
experience, Dr. Levine has been a leader in refractive cataract surgery, multifocal lens
implantation, and minimally invasive glaucoma procedures. He is dedicated to providing personalized
treatment, ensuring each patient receives the highest level of care for their vision needs.

[Read Full Bio][32]

## Our Services

[Glaucomain-Cliffside-Park-NJ]

###### Glaucoma

Glaucoma can develop without noticeable symptoms and may lead to serious vision loss if untreated.
At Cliffside Laser Eye and Cataract Center, Dr. Richard E. Levine provides glaucoma testing and care
to help detect and manage the condition early.

[Learn More][33]
[Cataracts treated in Cliffside Park NJ]

###### Cataracts

Cataracts cause gradual vision loss, but they can be safely treated to restore clear sight. At
Cliffside Laser Eye and Cataract Center, Dr. Richard E. Levine offers advanced cataract treatment to
help patients see more clearly, often reducing or eliminating the need for glasses.

[Learn More][34]
[LASIK offered in Cliffside Park NJ]

###### LASIK

LASIK is a quick, in-office laser procedure that corrects vision, often reducing or eliminating the
need for glasses or contacts. At Cliffside Laser Eye and Cataract Center, Dr. Richard E. Levine
offers LASIK for eligible patients seeking clearer vision with long-term results.

[Learn More][35]
[Dry-Eyes-in-Cliffside-Park-NJ.]

###### Dry Eyes

Dry eyes can be uncomfortable and may indicate an underlying condition that requires treatment. At
Cliffside Laser Eye and Cataract Center, Dr. Richard E. Levine provides comprehensive exams and
effective treatment options to help relieve persistent dry eye symptoms.

[Learn More][36]
[Eye-Exams offered in Cliffside Park NJ]

###### Eye Exams

Regular eye exams help detect vision problems and eye diseases early, preventing serious
complications. At Cliffside Laser Eye and Cataract Center, Dr. Richard E. Levine provides
comprehensive exams to assess vision, eye health, and conditions like glaucoma.

[Learn More][37]
[Laser-Floater-Removal-in-Cliffside-Park-NJ]

###### Laser Floater Removal

Eye floaters are common with age, but severe cases can interfere with vision and may require
treatment. At Cliffside Laser Eye and Cataract Center, Dr. Richard E. Levine offers laser floater
removal, a less invasive alternative to conventional surgery.

[Learn More][38]

**Turning technology into “Technology for Life”**

Dräger manufactures medical and safety technology products. In so doing, we protect, support, and
save people's lives around the world in hospitals, with fire departments, emergency services,
authorities, and in mining as well as industry. Founded in Lübeck in 1889, Dräger has grown into a
worldwide, listed enterprise in its fifth generation as a family-run business. Dräger has more than
16,000 employees worldwide and is present in over 190 countries around the globe. In 2023, the
company generated net sales of around EUR 3.4 billion.

Dräger technology is used all over the world. We operate in around 50 countries with our own sales
and service companies directly on location where our customers are.

**Turning technology into “Technology for Life”**

Dräger manufactures medical and safety technology products. In so doing, we protect, support, and
save people's lives around the world in hospitals, with fire departments, emergency services,
authorities, and in mining as well as industry. Founded in Lübeck in 1889, Dräger has grown into a
worldwide, listed enterprise in its fifth generation as a family-run business. Dräger has more than
16,000 employees worldwide and is present in over 190 countries around the globe. In 2023, the
company generated net sales of around EUR 3.4 billion.

Dräger technology is used all over the world. We operate in around 50 countries with our own sales
and service companies directly on location where our customers are.

store online via the X-node Hub.

models that could expand access, support earlier intervention, and bring advanced cell therapy
closer to community cancer settings.

[Featured Articles][23]

Brainomix founder and CEO Dr. Michalis Papadakis discusses how AI-powered imaging is helping drug
developers improve clinical trial design, identify meaningful treatment effects, and advance new
therapies in stroke, pulmonary fibrosis, and other areas of unmet need.

[Featured Articles][25]

### [DRUG-DEVICE COMBINATION PRODUCTS - Incorporating Self-Administered Drug-Device Combination
### Products Into Clinical Trials Can Bring Outsized Challenges & Outstanding Rewards][26]

improving patient convenience, dosing consistency, compliance, and real-world insight, but they
require careful early planning around usability, safety, regulatory requirements, compatibility,
manufacturing, and scale-up.

[Featured Articles][27]

### [DRUG DELIVERY - Improved Prediction of Food Effect on Oral Absorption][28]

Dissolution-permeation testing is helping drug developers better predict how food affects oral drug
absorption by measuring both drug solubilization and membrane permeation, reducing the risk of
misleading results from dissolution data alone.

[Featured Articles][29]

### [DRUG DEVELOPMENT - Drug Combination Screening in Oncology: Advancing Predictive Strategies for
### Precision Drug Development][30]

Drug combination screening is helping oncology developers identify synergistic drug pairs, connect
response patterns to tumor biology, and support more predictive, biomarker-guided strategies for
precision cancer treatment.

[Featured Articles][31]

### [SINGLE B CELL ANTIBODY DISCOVERY - Improving Therapeutic Candidate Selection in Drug
### Development][32]

Single B cell antibody discovery is helping improve therapeutic candidate selection by preserving
native heavy- and light-chain pairing, accelerating sequence-defined screening, and enabling earlier
identification of candidates with stronger specificity, function, and developability.

[Featured Articles][33]

### [CHEMOENZYMATIC LIGATION - Enabling Scalable, Sustainable Oligonucleotide Manufacturing][34]

Chemoenzymatic ligation offers a scalable, more sustainable path for oligonucleotide manufacturing
by combining SPOS fragment production with enzymatic assembly to improve purity, reduce impurities,
and support growing demand for nucleic acid therapeutics.

[Featured Articles][35]

### [CONTROLLED RELEASE - Precision in Every Dose: Advancing Controlled Release for Small Molecule
### Therapeutics][36]

Controlled release technologies are helping small molecule therapeutics deliver more consistent drug
exposure, improve patient adherence, reduce dosing frequency, and support more precise treatment
through advanced formulation and delivery strategies.

light therapy. This innovative device combines red and infrared light with micro pulses for an
instant glow and a long-term collagen boost. Safe and comfortable to use on the face, neck, chest
and arms, LMNT one integrates the power of the 633nm and unique NIR 830nm wavelengths, utilizing
coordinated micro pulses to achieve optimal results for your skin. Dermal heating promotes skin
elasticity and enhances collagen production, while these clinically proven wavelengths deliver
nourishing, healing energy that leaves your complexion fresh, radiant, and ready to glow.

[Lewis Carroll Society of North America]

Welcome to the Lewis Carroll Society of North America (LCSNA) website. The LCSNA is a non-profit
organization dedicated to promoting awareness and appreciation of the life, work, times, and
influence of Lewis Carroll (Charles Lutwidge Dodgson). Through conferences, public programs,
publications, research projects, and communications, we work to create knowledge and share awareness
of Carroll’s contributions to society and culture around the world. We are collectors, scholars,
actors, and enthusiasts of all ages and walks of life who share an affinity for *Alice’s Adventures
in Wonderland* and its heroine Alice (and enjoy much of muchness).

[Lewis Carroll]

**Charles Lutwidge Dodgson, **
*better known as*
**Lewis Carroll** (1832–1898)

1. Do fake designer sunglasses protect your eyes?
   
   Fake designer sunglasses often provide no protection against dangerous UV rays and could mean
   putting yourself at risk of developing serious eye conditions, such as cataract and macular
   degeneration which can lead to sight loss. Children are particularly susceptible to UV rays and
   should have their eyes protected even in lower UV conditions.
   
   You don’t need to buy expensive sunglasses to get the necessary protection. A budget pair of
   sunglasses from a reputable high street shop can offer as much UV protection as a designer brand.
   Your local [optometry practice][23] is also a great place to go if you need advice on the health
   of your eyes, and to find the perfect pair of fitted sunglasses.
   
   To make sure you have the necessary protection for your eyes, purchase sunglasses that have the
   UV mark, either the British Standard (BS EN ISO 12312-1:2013), CE or UKCA mark.
   
   [Read more about summer eye health][24]
2. What are floaters?
   
   Floaters are small dark or transparent dots or strands or something that looks like a hair or
   small pieces of a cobweb that float in the vitreous gel inside your eye. They are formed when the
   vitreous, which is the jelly inside your eye, separates into watery fluid and wavy collagen
   fibres. They appear to float in front of your eyes and move when you try to look at them. They
   are very common and are normally harmless.
   
   [Read more about floaters.][25]
3. What is long-sightedness (hyperopia)?
   
   Normally, light is focussed by the cornea and lens to form a sharp image on the retina.
   Long-sightedness occurs when the eyeball is slightly too short so that the focus point is behind
   the retina at the back of the eye. If you are long-sighted, you find it more difficult to see
   clearly objects that are close to you. For example, words on a page or your phone screen may seem
   blurred.
   
   [Read more about long-sightedness.][26]

#### Learn more about your eye condition and how LUCENTIS may be able to help.
#### Over 12 million doses have been given since 2006.

LUCENTIS^{®} (ranibizumab), a [VEGF inhibitor][15], treats [wet age-related macular
degeneration][16] (wAMD), [diabetic macular edema (DME) and diabetic retinopathy (DR)][17], [macular
edema following retinal vein occlusion][18] (RVO), and [myopic choroidal neovascularization][19]
(mCNV).

LUCENTIS is designed to block vascular endothelial (VASS‐cue‐ler end‐oh‐THEEL‐e‐ull) growth factor,
or [VEGF][20] (vej‐EFF), from inside the eye. This may help reduce unhealthy swelling, leaking, and
growth of blood vessels, which helps maintain vision.

Lucentis is administered via [intravitreal injection][21] into the eye, typically performed monthly
or as advised by your healthcare provider. 

Serious risks such as infections, retinal detachments, or arterial thromboembolic events (ATEs) are
rare. Monitoring intraocular pressure before and after treatment is essential. Seek immediate care
if any severe vision changes or signs of infection occur.

Common [side effects of LUCENTIS][22] include conjunctival hemorrhage, eye pain, vitreous floaters,
and intraocular pressure (IOP). Some individuals may also experience redness or discomfort after the
injection.

#### Important Safety Information

Back to Top

**Who is LUCENTIS for?** LUCENTIS^{®} (ranibizumab injection) is a prescription medicine for the
treatment of patients with:
* wet age-related macular degeneration (wAMD)
* macular edema following retinal vein occlusion (RVO)
* diabetic macular edema (DME)
* diabetic retinopathy (DR)
* myopic choroidal neovascularization (mCNV)

**What important safety information should I know about LUCENTIS?** You should not use LUCENTIS if
you have an infection in or around the eye or are allergic to LUCENTIS or any of its ingredients.
LUCENTIS is a prescription medication given by injection into the eye, and it has side effects. Some
LUCENTIS patients have had detached retinas and serious eye infections. If your eye becomes red,
sensitive to light, or painful, or if you have a change in vision, call or visit your eye doctor
right away.

Some LUCENTIS patients have had increases in eye pressure before and within 1 hour of an injection.

Uncommonly, LUCENTIS patients have had serious, sometimes fatal, problems related to blood clots,
such as heart attacks or strokes. Fatal events were seen more often in patients with DME and DR with
LUCENTIS compared with patients who did not receive LUCENTIS. Although there were only few fatal
events which included causes of death typical of patients with advanced diabetic complications,
these events may be caused by LUCENTIS.

Severe inflammation of vessels in the retina has happened for patients treated with LUCENTIS. Call
your healthcare provider immediately if you experience a change in vision.

Some LUCENTIS patients have serious side effects related to the injection. These include serious
infections inside the eye, detached retinas, and cataracts. The most common eye-related side effects
are increased redness in the white of the eye, eye pain, small specks in vision, and increased eye
pressure. The most common non–eye-related side effects are nose and throat infections, anemia,
nausea and cough. Ask your doctor if you have questions or want more information.

You may report side effects to the FDA at (800) FDA-1088 or [www.fda.gov/medwatch][23]. You may also
report side effects to Genentech at (888) 835-2555.

**For additional Safety Information, please talk to your doctor and see the [LUCENTIS full
Prescribing Information][24].**

## How can we help you?

In all our years of serving Texans, Mann Eye Institute has built a reputation that generations of
families have come to trust. From routine eye exams and glasses and contacts to advanced LASIK,
modern cataract surgery and the latest advancements in diagnosing and treating eye diseases, Mann
Eye Institute can expertly care for every member of your family.

[Learn About Our Services][51]

## Advanced LASIK

What could your life be like if you didn’t have the hassles of glasses and contacts? Can you see it?
One less restriction. One less inconvenience. One less thing to worry about. Talk to our team to
discover what visual freedom could do for you!

[Learn about Advanced LASIK][52]

## Laser Cataract Surgery

More than two million men and women undergo cataract surgery every year, making it one of the most
common and successful medical procedures in the U.S. today. And laser cataract surgery represents
one of the great surgical advancements of our time, offering additional safety, precision and
consistency of results.

[Learn about Laser Cataract Surgery][53]

## Reading Vision Correction

If you’ve lost the crisp, clear vision of your youth, you may be tempted to think you’ll spend the
rest of your days dependent on reading glasses to see things like menus, books, food labels and text
on your phone. Think again! We have several options to address and correct your reading vision woes.

[Learn about Reading Vision Correction][54]

## Refractive Lens Exchange

Refractive Lens Exchange is a customizable vision correction solution that has helped so many people
just like you to see clearly with reduced dependency on glasses, contacts and even readers.

[Learn about Refractive Lens Exchange][55]

## Dry Eye

Dry Eye is more common today than ever before. And while your issue could be allergy-related,
experts agree that screen time (things like computers, smartphones, video gaming) is likely to blame
for dry eye symptoms in many cases. But just because it’s common doesn’t mean you have to live with
it!

[Learn about Dry Eye Treatment][56]

## Treatment of Glaucoma

Glaucoma, known as the silent thief of sight, is one of the leading causes of blindness in the world
today. It often comes with no symptoms – especially in early stages. Early detection is key! 

[Learn about Glacuoma Treatment][57]

## Cornea Procedures

Many corneal conditions and diseases threaten the health of your eyes and, ultimately, your vision.
Since the cornea is responsible for much of your eye’s focusing power, it’s important to see an
experienced cornea expert with any corneal concerns.

[Learn about Cornea Treatment][58]

## General Eye Care

allows for early detection of vision problems such as macular degeneration, diabetic eye changes,

any stage of life.

[Learn about General Eye Care][60]

all around the world is on the rise. At Mann Eye Institute, we are leaders in the management of
Myopic Progression (where the nearsightedness gets worse year over year).

[Learn about Myopia Management][61]

# Welcome to North Fulton Eye Center & Cumming Eye Clinic

Our Ophthalmology practice is an independent, physician-owned practice, providing truly personalized
care that larger corporate practices often cannot match. This independence affords us the
opportunity to spend ample time with each patient and personally oversee every pre- and
post-operative visit, ensuring continuity and a trusted relationship at every step of your
comprehensive care. Proudly serving Fulton County and Forsyth County since 1984.

## Dr. Susanne Hewitt

## Dr. Susanne Hewitt

Dr. Susanne Hewitt is a board certified and fellowship trained Ophthalmologist who specializes in
cataract surgery, refractive surgery including LASIK and PRK, corneal transplantation, and
management of complex corneal disease. A native of Florida, Dr. Hewitt has been serving patients in
the Roswell, Alpharetta, and Cumming area for over 15 years.

## 
## Dr. Lauren Snellings

Dr. Lauren (Lexie) Snellings is an ophthalmologist specializing in laser assisted cataract surgery
and comprehensive eye care. She provides medical treatment for a wide range of conditions, including
dry eye syndrome, glaucoma, diabetic retinopathy, macular degeneration, and more.

[ Read More About Dr. Lauren Snellings ][78]

## Dr. Hannah Park

## Dr. Hannah Park

Dr. Park is a board certified Ophthalmologist who specializes in cataract surgery as well as
comprehensive eye care. She offers advanced intraocular lens technologies for cataract surgery,
including toric (astigmatism correcting), multifocal, and extended depth of focus lenses. Dr. Park
performs femtosecond laser assisted cataract surgery and Microincisional Glaucoma Surgery (MIGS) for
those who are candidates.

cataracts cause blurry vision and may continue to grow until treated or removed. Common treatment
methods include stronger eyeglass prescriptions or the surgical removal of the cataract with
intraocular lens implantation.

### Diagnosis & Treatment

## Laser Cataract Surgery

A cataract is the clouding of the eye’s lens. Caused by the clumping of protein in the lens,
cataracts cause blurry vision and may continue to grow until treated or removed. Common treatment
methods include stronger eyeglass prescriptions or the surgical removal of the cataract with
intraocular lens implantation.

[Learn More][87] [ Cataract Self-Test][88]
[Happy woman]

### Surgical & Non-Surgical

## Cosmetic & Oculoplastic Services

North Georgia Eye Associates offers the latest in surgical and non-surgical treatments to help you
look and feel your very best, including skincare products, injectables, non-injectables and laser
treatments. Oculoplastic procedures combine the accuracy and precision found in ophthalmic surgeries
with the aesthetic foundations of plastic surgery.

[Learn More][89]
[Happy couple outside]

### Advanced Technology

## LASIK

Laser-assisted in-situ Keratomileusis (LASIK) is an FDA-approved vision correction procedure that
corrects refractive errors. These include nearsightedness, farsightedness, and astigmatism. It is
performed on nearly 1 million patients annually to help reduce dependency on visual aids and provide
visual freedom. LASIK works because it permanently reshapes the cornea using an excimer and
femtosecond laser.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is an IV Drip Lounge?
An IV drip lounge is a wellness space where licensed medical professionals administer hydration,
vitamins, and targeted infusions designed around your needs.
What is an IV Drip Bar?
It is another name for an IV therapy location that offers hydration and nutrient infusions in a
comfortable, service-focused setting.
Are IV Drips Safe?
When administered by qualified clinicians after an appropriate health review, IV drips are designed
to be a safe and supervised wellness treatment.
What IV is best for me?
The best option depends on your goals, health history, and symptoms. A quick consult helps determine
the most appropriate treatment plan.
Why Is My IV Drip So Slow?
Flow rate can vary based on the infusion type, your comfort, hydration level, and what your provider
recommends for a safe treatment.

# Change in the Executive Board: Anderson and Herfeld hand over to Sowada and Wallisch

The PHOENIX group announces a change in its Executive Board effective 1 February 2026. Steve
Anderson and Stefan Herfeld will step down from their roles as Executive Board Members at their own
request.

[ read more ][19]

# PHOENIX group adopts climate target

The company has set an official target to become CO2 -neutral in its own business operations by the
year 2030. We want to avoid and reduce our emissions by at least 30 per cent (Scope 1 + 2
emissions). PHOENIX thereby underlines its commitment to creating added value for society and the
environment beyond our mission in the healthcare sector.

[ read more ][20]

# PHOENIX group presents LEAN Award 2025 recognising outstanding projects

We introduced lean management in our organisation two years ago with the goal to achieve continuous
improvements and drive cultural change. 

[ read more ][21]

## Working at PHOENIX

We are a successful company with a Europe-wide presence – with the **down-to-earth
attitude** typically found in a family business. Our success is due to our highly committed
employees.

### Age-Related Macular Degeneration (AMD)

### Clinician Scientific and Educational Resources

AMD can cause profound impairments to central vision; however, early recognition and prompt
treatment of exudative disease can potentially stabilize or reverse vision loss. Staying current
with the latest information on presentation, prognosis, monitoring, and treatment advances is
critical for ensuring optimal vision health in people with AMD.

Learn more about AMD pathophysiology and pearls of assessment of atrophic (“dry”) and neovascular
(“wet”) AMD, as well as available treatment strategies, patient education, and clinical trial
resources, by exploring different topics within the portal. High-definition animations, apps, and
other tools for your mobile phone about AMD, related symptoms, and treatment can be found in HD
Visual Learning.

include pain and redness, or are allergic to pegcetacoplan or any ingredients in SYFOVRE. SYFOVRE
can cause serious allergic reactions such as trouble breathing, tongue, face, lips, or mouth
swelling, rashes, and hives.

swelling, rashes, and hives.

overall understanding of the current market scenario.

people suffer from AMD (1.75 million individuals have advanced forms of AMD). One question
consistently asked is if Macular Degeneration is hereditary? 70% of the cause of AMD is due to
genetics. To learn more and see how we can help, [click here][44].
